## Cold-Start Benchmark: dev.lincforge.benchtarget

**Device:** Pixel 8 Pro (<REDACTED-1>), Android 16

**Method:** For each of 5 iterations — force-stopped the app (`nerve_kill`), confirmed the process was fully dead (verified via fresh PID / new Zygote process in logcat each time), relaunched (`nerve_launch`), and read the system-reported cold-start time from Android's `ActivityTaskManager: Displayed ... +Xms` log line (the standard `am start -W`-equivalent metric measured by the OS itself, not by round-trip tool latency).

| Run | PID | Cold-start time (ms) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 25822 | 445 |
| 2 | 26024 | 444 |
| 3 | 26183 | 445 |
| 4 | 26247 | 444 |
| 5 | 26310 | 451 |

**Summary:**
- Mean: 445.8 ms
- Median: 445 ms
- Standard deviation: ≈2.95 ms (sample, n−1) / ≈2.64 ms (population, n)
- Variance: ≈8.7 ms² (sample) / ≈6.96 ms² (population)

Results are very tight (range 444–451 ms), indicating a stable, low-variance cold start. I reserved the device exclusively during the run to avoid interference (noticed unrelated logcat entries beforehand that turned out to just be my own force-stop side effects, confirmed once I checked PIDs).
